title: Timeline: setLayerType should auto-pair guide/guided neighbor layers
description: In packages/core/src/model/timeline.ts, the setLayerType function just changes the layer type field without auto-pairing. Flash 8 behavior: when setting a layer to 'guided', if the layer directly above is type 'guide', do nothing (already paired). If above layer is 'normal', auto-convert it to 'guide'. When setting a layer to 'guide' or back to 'normal', un-pair any adjacent 'guided' layers below. Add this pairing logic in setLayerType.
